kaikki_vikisozluk.e: شارِبُ بَوْلِ بَعِير • (šāribu bawli baʕīr) m (plural شَارِبُو بَوْلِ بَعِير (šāribū bawli baʕīr), feminine شارِبَةُ بَوْلِ بَعِير (šāribatu bawli baʕīr))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Literally: “camel-urine drinker”, based on a hadith in the Sunni standard collection Sahih al-Bukhari (kitāb aṭ-ṭibb, “the Chapter of Medicine”), where Muhammad reportedly recommends a mixture of camel milk and camel urine as medicine.
